<plugin id="strictClockModel.$(n)" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" spec="starbeast3.evolution.branchratemodel.StrictClockModelSB3"> <clock.rate id="SpeciesTreeStrictClockRate" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="1.0" estimate="false"/> </plugin>
<operator id="strictClockRateScaler" scaleFactor="0.7" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" parameter="@SpeciesTreeStrictClockRate" weight="3.0"/> <distribution id="SB3StrictClockPrior" spec='beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal' param="@SpeciesTreeStrictClockRate" meanInRealSpace="true" M="0.001" S="3" />
Prior on species tree strict clock rate
Scale operator for species tree strict clock rate

<plugin id="relaxedClockModel.$(n)" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" spec="starbeast3.evolution.branchratemodel.UCRelaxedClockModelSB3" estimateRoot="true" > <clock.rate id="SpeciesTreeRelaxedClockRate.$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="1.0" estimate="false"/> <realRates id="BranchRates.$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealVectorParam" domain="NonNegativeReal" estimate="true" >1</realRates> <stdev id="SpeciesTreeRelaxedClockSD.$(n)" estimate="true" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal">0.1</stdev> </plugin>
<operator id="relaxedClockRateScaler.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.7" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" parameter="@SpeciesTreeRelaxedClockRate.$(n)" weight="3.0"/> <distribution spec='beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal' id="SB3RelaxedClockPrior.$(n)" param="@SpeciesTreeRelaxedClockRate.$(n)" meanInRealSpace="true" M="0.001" S="3" />
<distribution spec='beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Gamma' id="ucldStdevPrior.clock.$(n)" param="@SpeciesTreeRelaxedClockSD.$(n)" alpha="5" beta="0.05" />
<distribution spec='beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal' id="FastRatePriorDistributionClock.$(n)" param="@BranchRates.$(n)" M="1.0" S="@SpeciesTreeRelaxedClockSD.$(n)" meanInRealSpace="true"/>
<operator id="AdaptableOperatorSampler.ucldStdev:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.operator.AdaptableOperatorSampler" weight="5.0" parameter="@SpeciesTreeRelaxedClockSD.$(n)"> <operator id="UcldStdevScale.clock.$(n)" parameter="@SpeciesTreeRelaxedClockSD.$(n)" scaleFactor="0.5" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" weight="1"/> <operator id="SampleFromPriorOperator.c:ucldStdev.$(n)" parameter="@SpeciesTreeRelaxedClockSD.$(n)" prior="@ucldStdevPrior.clock.$(n)" spec="orc.operators.SampleFromPriorOperator" weight="1"/> </operator>
<operator id="AdaptableOperatorSampler.rates:$(n)" parameter="@BranchRates.$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.operator.AdaptableOperatorSampler" weight="20"> <operator id="Scale.branchRates.$(n)" parameter="@BranchRates.$(n)" scaleFactor="0.75" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" weight="1.0"/> <operator id="SampleFromPriorOperator.branchRates.$(n)" np="1" parameter="@BranchRates.$(n)" prior="@FastRatePriorDistributionClock.$(n)" spec="orc.operators.SampleFromPriorOperator" weight="1"/> <operator id="ConstantDistanceOperatorSpeciesTree:$(n)" clock="@relaxedClockModel.$(n)" popsizes="@popSize" proportionalToBranchLength="true" spec="starbeast3.operators.ConstantDistanceOperatorSpeciesTree" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" twindowSize="0.1" weight="1.0" /> </operator>
<operator id="NEROperator_dAE_dBE_dCE.$(n)" rates="@BranchRates.$(n)" spec="orc.ner.NEROperator_dAE_dBE_dCE" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" weight="1"/>
<log branchratemodel="@relaxedClockModel.$(n)" id="RateStatLogger.$(n)" spec="beast.base.evolution.RateStatistic" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/>
